hook.name: BerylPadHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A BerylPad launchpad hook that enforces asymmetric static LP fees (separate buy and sell rates for the launched token) and collects a 20% protocol fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta adjustments. Includes a time-limited MEV protection module active immediately after pool launch and optional configurable pool extensions.
